fun_facts: Ollie Gordon II’s hometown is Fort Worth, Texas.
As a freshman at Oklahoma State, Ollie Gordon II rushed for 308 yards and two touchdowns.
In 2023, Ollie Gordon II rushed for 1,732 yards and 21 touchdowns.
Ollie Gordon II became Oklahoma State’s first Doak Walker Award winner; his five rushing touchdowns against BYU tied Barry Sanders’ school record.
In 2026, Ollie Gordon II had his first 100-yard NFL game with 100 yards on nine carries, including a career-long 53-yard run.
